mapper.select: select count(*) + 1 from evaluation_batch_requests where job_type = 'DELETION'
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_requests (batch_id, job_type, target_condition_json, request_user_id, request_status, request_id) values (#{batchId}, #{jobType}, #{targetConditionJson}::jsonb, #{requestUserId}, 'COMPLETED', #{requestId})

insert into evaluation_batch_results (batch_id, job_type, total_count, success_count, failure_count, excluded_count, error_detail_json, request_id) values (#{batchId}, #{jobType}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{excludedCount}, '[]'::jsonb, #{requestId}) on conflict (batch_id) do update set total_count = excluded.total_count, success_count = excluded.success_count, failure_count = excluded.failure_count, excluded_count = excluded.excluded_count, error_detail_json = excluded.error_detail_json, request_id = excluded.request_id
